title: Remarxk's Mechanical Spawner
description: Added a Mechanical Spawner in the stress spawn mob.
body:
## 1. Description
This mod introduces a new machine: the **Mechanical Spawner**.  
As the name suggests, it integrates with Create and adds a stress-powered device capable of spawning mobs.

## 2. Setting the Spawned Mob
You can craft an empty Mechanical Spawner and configure it in the following ways:

- **Sneak + Right-click** a vanilla spawner while facing it to copy its mob type.
- **Right-click with a spawn egg** on the Mechanical Spawner to directly set the mob type.

## 3. Stress-Driven Spawning
The Mechanical Spawner operates by consuming **Stress Units (SU)** from Create’s kinetic network.

- The spawner will generate the configured mob when supplied with stress.
- Higher rotational speed increases the spawning rate.
- Increased speed also causes spawned mobs to be launched farther away upon spawning.
